name: Jacques Vallée
credentials: PhD astrofísica Northwestern + pionero ARPANET/Internet + venture capitalist
bio_short: Durante sesenta años fue el principal contrapeso intelectual a la hipótesis extraterrestre dentro de la investigación seria del fenómeno. Su 'hipótesis del sistema de control' (1975) sostiene que la inteligencia detrás del fenómeno regula la creencia humana mediante revelaciones dosificadas que nunca se confirman. Medio siglo después, la desclasificación PURSUE de 2026 —filtración curada, sin confirmación oficial y sincronizada con la cultura— encaja con ese pronóstico, lo que volvió su marco la lente interpretativa dominante.

credentials_en: PhD in astrophysics, Northwestern + ARPANET/Internet pioneer + venture capitalist
bio_short_en: For sixty years he was the leading intellectual counterweight to the extraterrestrial hypothesis within serious research on the phenomenon. His 'control system hypothesis' (1975) holds that the intelligence behind the phenomenon regulates human belief through dosed revelations that are never confirmed. Half a century later, the 2026 PURSUE disclosure —a curated leak, with no official confirmation and synchronized with the culture— fits that forecast, which made his framework the dominant interpretive lens.
